item.title: Livingston Parish Sheriff's Office investigating early morning fatal shooting
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS -&nbsp;The Livingston Parish Sheriff's Office is investigating a fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday morning.&nbsp;According to the sheriff's office, deputies arrived on Longwood Drive around 3 a.m. to find 22-year-old Tyree Worthy suffering from gunshot wounds. item.title: Pain-relieving ointment sold at Walmart and Target recalled
item.description: BATON ROUGE -&nbsp;A pain-relieving ointment sold at Walmart and Target was recalled on Thursday, according to the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission.Mamisan Pain Relieving Topical Ointment, containing lidocaine, was recalled due to the packaging not being child-resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act.The current packaging poses a risk of serious injury or death from poisoning if the ointment is consumed by small children, according to the CPSC.&nbsp;The recall

item.description: BATON ROUGE - Hundreds of children in Baton Rouge received help this week as a local biker group worked to alleviate the impact of child poverty during the holiday season.The Nubian Kruzers hosted their annual toy giveaway in North Baton Rouge, distributing free toys to 400 children from families in need. item.title: St. Luke's Episcopal Church hosts longest night service
item.description: BATON ROUGE - St. Luke's Episcopal Church hosted its annual longest night service on Sunday evening.&nbsp;It was a quiet, reflective gathering for anyone feeling grief, loss or the weight of the holidays. The service offered a calm space with gentle music, soft lighting and moments of silence.&nbsp;The service acknowledged many kinds of loss and included a candle lighting as a symbol of hope.&nbsp;St. Luke's says the message is simple: it's okay to not be okay, but hope remains.&nbsp;Permalink|
